newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BROKERS SEE SHARE LOSSES, LOW TURNOVER.
newsitem.headline: BROKERS SEE SHARE LOSSES, LOW TURNOVER.

text.p: Brokers said they expected a lackluster day on Lithuania's bourse as some popular shares lost ground on Monday.
"I think turnover and share prices will be down a little," said Saulius Merkys, a broker with Vilfima.
Sanitas slid to 85.00 litas from 90.00 litas, but one broker said it would likely recover.
"I think it will go a bit higher," Merkys said.
Dirbtinis Plaushtas fell to 0.49 litas from 0.54 litas, after losing about 37 percent last week.
"There is just no interest in these shares among local investors," said Kazimieras Liepis, a broker with Mendes Prior Europe.
Birziai Dairy dropped to 9.53 litas from 9.70 litas. Birziai had enjoyed a long stay at 10.25 litas before being knocked down to 9.70 litas last week.
"The price above ten litas was too high," said Merkys.
"There were orders all the time for 10,000 shares and 20,000 shares, and now they're gone," Merkys said.
Lithuanian Gas made progress, advancing to 1.72 litas from 1.70 litas.
Hermis Bank held steady at 180.00 litas.
"I think it will stay at that level for two weeks," Merkys said.
